name.description: The name of the layout from which to undock the view

viewID.description: The unique id of the view to undock.

posX.description: Position of the undocked view on the horizontal axis. Defaults to 0.

posY.description: Position of the undocked view on the vertical axis. Defaults to 0.

examples.description: Creates a floating view, at the given position, from a docked view in a layout.
examples.title: Undock a view from a layout
